A table nested in a single-cell row renders as its own table

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<table><tr><th>Summary</th></tr><tr><td>Before<table><tr><th>Item</th><th>Amount</th></tr><tr><td>Alpha</td><td>10</td></tr></table></td></tr></table>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
